widgets.title: Registry Integrity
widgets.markdown:
### Registry Integrity

```
factory-releases/
  skills.lock.json    ← SHA-256 for all 15 SKILL.md files
  tools.lock.json     ← MCP endpoint identities + approved tool names
  active.yaml         ← current active FactoryRelease version
```

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `pnpm factory registry:verify` | Verify all 15 SHA-256 digests match locked values — fails CI if mismatch |
| `pnpm lock-components` | Recompute digests after editing any SKILL.md |
| `pnpm factory doctor` | Full prerequisite check including registry + Port + DB + sandbox |

**Skill approval lifecycle:** `PENDING → APPROVED → DEPRECATED | REVOKED`

Only `APPROVED` skills can be referenced in a `FactoryRelease`. A `REVOKED` skill must be replaced before the release can be promoted.
